summary: RegenCell Biosciences Holdings Ltd filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 985,222 ordinary shares at $20.30 per share (a ~27% discount to the $27.79 closing price on May 18, 2026). Univest Securities acts as placement agent on a best-efforts basis, receiving 6.5% cash fees and also purchasing 49,262 shares as principal for $1M. This is a standard equity capital raise, not a special situation, as it lacks acquisition, divestiture, activism, strategic review, or other transformative elements.
